fusions.name: Heel Cutter
fusions.desc: Rushes you to an enemy up to 7 tiles away and bites down, which deals 13 damage, leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, up to 7 tiles away. The bite deals 18 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bait and Heel
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds. For 8 seconds a hound fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Kennelled Fang
fusions.desc: A bonded hound fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving its target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.
